# E5-LS1-T5 grounded source cards

## AIM01 — The 2025 AI Index Report
- Source: Stanford HAI (2025)
- URL: https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-index/2025-ai-index-report
- Type: research_report
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Stanford reports record U.S. private AI investment of $109.1B in 2024 and global generative AI investment of $33.9B.

## AIM02 — State of AI Report: 6 trends shaping the landscape in 2025
- Source: CB Insights (2025)
- URL: https://www.cbinsights.com/research/report/ai-trends-2024/
- Type: research_report
- Evidence strength: medium
- Notes: CB Insights says AI funding surpassed $100B in 2024 and large AI rounds drove the market.

## AIM03 — State of AI Q2'24 Report
- Source: CB Insights (2024)
- URL: https://www.cbinsights.com/research/report/ai-trends-q2-2024/
- Type: research_report
- Evidence strength: medium
- Notes: Quarterly update noting AI funding hit $23.2B in Q2 2024, useful for trend context but not full-year totals.

## AIM04 — The state of AI in early 2024
- Source: McKinsey (2024)
- URL: https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-state-of-ai-2024
- Type: survey
- Evidence strength: medium
- Notes: Widely cited AI adoption survey, useful context for business usage but not the cleanest market-size source.

## AIM05 — Gartner Forecasts Worldwide AI Chips Revenue to Grow 33% in 2024
- Source: Gartner (2024)
- URL: https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2024-05-29-gartner-forecasts-worldwide-artificial-intelligence-chips-revenue-to-grow-33-percent-in-2024
- Type: press_release
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Gartner forecasts global AI semiconductor revenue at $71B in 2024.

## AIM06 — Market Share: AI Processing Semiconductors by End Market, Worldwide, 2024
- Source: Gartner (2025)
- URL: https://www.gartner.com/en/documents/6645534
- Type: research_summary
- Evidence strength: high
- Notes: Gartner summary says AI processing semiconductors reached $135.3B in 2024, much larger than earlier-stage figures.

- Source: Stanford HAI (2019)
